text:
suspected: Codex review run with -s read-only wrote a task-store mutation in the primary checkout
suspected: Observed 2026-10-15 in the V1-1375/1334 lane (PR #938). The lane's single Codex review (codex exec -s read-only, from the lane clone) ran `corvint-tasks ticket note set ticket:corvint:main:V1-1375 --role OWNER` in /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint; it succeeded as receipt .git/taskman/receipts/000000006212.json (MUTATION, actor russelllewis role OWNER, ticket revision 2, 17:42 local). Expected: a read-only review cannot mutate the native store and never claims the OWNER role. Actual: mutation recorded as OWNER. Possible causes: corvint-tasks resolves the primary checkout outside the sandbox's writable roots, or the sandbox does not cover .git/taskman; the review prompt did not forbid corvint-tasks.

text:
dispatch: acquire and hold the pool member for a session that needs one; release it on attempt end (GitHub #1147)
GitHub beamfall/corvint#1147 (owner, 2026-10-18). A ticket whose session needs a pool member must currently acquire it from inside the session. If the worker ends (context limit, crash, budget stop) while that acquire is in flight, the allocation is abandoned and stays allocated or quarantined until a sweep. Expected: for a ticket that declares a pool requirement, the dispatcher acquires the member before launch, hands the allocation to the session (env or handoff file), and releases it when the attempt ends, whatever the session did. Related, not duplicated: V1-1573 (acquire at claim time, a follow-up of capacity slots) and V1-0800 (requiresPool omitted). New requirements belong in the pool-safe-reuse (PSR) or attempt-runner (ATR) spec, not the leases spec, which is over its bound.
note: V1-1833 says "Related, not duplicated: V1-1573"; a negative pair

text:
tests: the 20 slowest single tests take 25% of CI test time (145-418 s each; LGLV0009 418 s)
Measured on batch 1025i CI run 40246146353 (2026-10-25, 8 self-hosted go-product shards, go test -json Elapsed). The 347 packages took 15,757 s of test time. The 20 slowest top-level tests take about 3,950 s, which is 25% of the total, and each one alone is longer than most packages:

- 418 s internal/tasks/store TestLGLV0009_SealedBaseDeclinesRewrittenSegment
- 276 s internal/doccorpus TestDCPV1216LegacyDiscoveryGitOpsIndependentOfPathCount
- 217 s internal/tasks/store TestLGLV0009_SealedBaseDeclinesChangedState
- 207 s cmd/corvint TestPackSnapshotReadsWithoutChangingAByteOnTwentyTasks
- 204 s internal/doccorpus TestDCRV1552ParallelScanMatchesSequential
- 199 s internal/docviews TestVerifyRejectsCanonicalBundleOver64MiB
- 197 s tools/corvint-pr-tests TestAFPV0048ShardedRunExecutesSlices
- 189 s internal/tasks/store TestCALV0089_ProgramWallExpiryEndsContinuation
- 173 s internal/doccorpus/selfcorpus TestCorpusSelfDocumentation
- 170 s internal/tasks/store TestJSGV0020_HarnessRunsBothModes
- 169 s internal/tasks/store TestCALV0044_HandoffPolicyReceiptInterval
- 165 s internal/companionrelease TestCorvintBundledBinariesBuildTwiceIdentically
- 159 s internal/doccorpus TestDCPV1216SymbolAnchorsGitOpsIndependentOfAnchorCount
- 159 s cmd/corvint TestBlobShardsReadOnlyTwentyTaskMatrix
- 153 s internal/doccorpus TestDCPV1091TestKnowledgeQueryExposure
- 151 s internal/doccorpus TestDCPV1216PlaywrightDiscoveryGitOpsIndependentOfPathCount
- 147 s internal/tasks/store TestATRV0297_ReassignRemovesPriorStageWorktrees
- 146 s internal/tasks/store TestLGLV0009_PoolVerbsResumeFromSealedBase
- 146 s internal/tasks/store TestCALV0371_MovedWorktreeKeepsItsRecord
- 145 s tools/corvint-pr-tests TestSelectedFailureAndFallback

A single test cannot be split across shards, so these set a floor on shard wall time and on every lane run that selects them. Likely causes to check per test: fixture sizes larger than the property needs (64 MiB bundle, twenty-task matrices, path-count scaling sweeps), repeated builds of the same binaries, and serial subtests that could run in parallel. Related, not duplicated: V1-0961 and V1-1108 (internal/tasks/store package time and mutexes), V1-0643 (doccorpus hermetic fixtures), V1-1753 (shard balance), V1-1100 (per-test cost table).
note: V1-2740 says "Related, not duplicated: V1-0961"; a negative pair

corvint-tasks: criterion-binding capture/verify --help returns ERROR, failing CAL-V0-047 on main
